title: Diagnose the Windows test that stalls on a single item with 20,000 notes
outcome: Diagnose the Windows test that stalls on a single item with 20,000 notes
acceptance: The operation the 20,000-note single-item test case drives is identified, with how its work grows with the item's note count, from code reading and a bounded measurement at smaller counts
The superlinear path, if any, is fixed or filed with evidence, and the test completes on Windows within a stated bound
No timeout is raised and no test is skipped to hide the stall
disposal_reason: Duplicate filed at the same time on Windows B by Engram::Opus-WinB-Coder4 with the root cause: the 20,000-note stall is quadratic fixture setup, because each note re-lists and re-persists the run's full evidence list (evidence.rs:202; checkpoints.rs:243-271). w-3b36da2305c7 carries the fix acceptance.
